rounds.text: Asarfi Hospital Ltd presents a compelling value opportunity supported by robust operational performance and attractive valuation multiples relative to its sector [E6, E11]. The company trades at a P/E of 24.9x against a massive sector benchmark of 105.16x, while boasting a strong return on equity of 17.06% compared to a negative sector benchmark of -33.33% [E1, E6, E9]. Growth metrics further underpin the bull case, with compounded sales growth reaching 49% over the trailing twelve months and compounded profit growth hitting 60% over the same period [E16, E19]. Financial health remains sound with positive money flow from institutional investors, fully cash-backed profits through a cash conversion of 1.12x, and a discounted cash flow model pointing toward a substantial margin of safety of 38.7% [E29, E39, E41]. Conceded: [E48] Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend, and [E34] borrowings have increased to Rs 58 Cr in Mar 2026 from Rs 49 Cr a year earlier.
